bio: This restaurant has become something of an institution in the region. The Wieland-Stuben has been a byword for classic cuisine since 1965. The elegant, tastefully decorated dining area makes for a really appealing setting, as does the gorgeous garden terrace. In their classic French cuisine, Lukas Erfurth and his team use only selected ingredients that impress with their freshness and quality. You can opt for the set menu or dine à la carte. The excellent service comes courtesy of a team headed up by sommelier Ronja. On Sundays, there is a three-course set menu (no à la carte dishes)....
